about: Do not open a public issue; follow SECURITY.md
title: "DO NOT SUBMIT SECURITY DETAILS"
labels: security
---

Stop. Do not submit vulnerability details, credentials, evidence, or deployment information here.
Follow the private reporting instructions in `SECURITY.md`. If no verified private channel is
available, contact the repository owner independently and disclose only minimal non-secret context.
